name: instructor-motion-app
description: Instructor Motion — native wrapper (Capacitor) around the same web app

scripts.prepare-web: mkdir -p www && cp ../index.html ../manifest.webmanifest ../sw.js www/ && cp -r ../icons www/
scripts.android: npm run prepare-web && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run prepare-web && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.sync: npm run prepare-web && npx cap sync
